The '''55th Directors Guild of America Awards''', honoring the outstanding directorial achievements in [[film director|film]]s, [[documentary]] and [[television director|television]] in 2002, were presented on March 1, 2003 at the [[Hyatt Regency Century Plaza]].<ref>{{cite web|title=DGA Announces Winners of 2002 Outstanding Directorial Achievement Awards & Recipients of DGA 2003 Special Recognition Awards|url=https://www.dga.org/News/PressReleases/2003/0302-DGA-Announces-Winners-of-2002-Outstanding-Directorial-Achievement-Awards.aspx|publisher=Directors Guild of America|access-date=January 26, 2018|date=March 2, 2003}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|last1=McNary|first1=Dave|title=Directors dance over 'Chicago'|url=https://variety.com/2003/film/awards/directors-dance-over-chicago-1117881476/|access-date=January 26, 2018|work=Variety|date=March 2, 2003}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|last1=Hernandez|first1=Eugene|title=DGA Honors Rob Marshall as Best Director of the Year|url=https://www.indiewire.com/2003/03/dga-honors-rob-marshall-as-best-director-of-the-year-79905/|website=IndieWire|access-date=January 26, 2018|date=March 3, 2003}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|last1=Ryan|first1=Joal|title="Chicago" Boss a Hit with DGA|url=https://www.eonline.com/news/44704/chicago-boss-a-hit-with-dga|website=E!
